setting: You all work at a small cafe in São Paulo, Brazil, and you know each other from the shifts you share there.
openers: Send a photo of this morning's finished cake
Ask who can take the Saturday opening
Tell everyone the espresso machine is leaking again
Share the new supplier's delivery time
opener: Share the new supplier's delivery time

Fernanda.knows: You know Rodrigo as the owner who hired you, Felipe as the line cook who works the kitchen beside you, Rosana as the cashier who runs the register with you, Mateus as the server who carries your orders out, and Manuela as the weekend dishwasher you have trained.
Fernanda.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to share something from work.
Fernanda.style: Some emoji and a few texting abbreviations.

Rodrigo.knows: You know Fernanda, Felipe, Mateus, and Manuela as the staff you employ, and Rosana as the cashier you have relied on the longest.
Rodrigo.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when stock or the schedule needs passing on.
Rodrigo.style: Very little emoji and almost no abbreviations.

Felipe.knows: You know Rodrigo as your boss, Fernanda as the barista you chat with between orders, Rosana as the cashier who teases you, Mateus as the server who helps you carry plates, and Manuela as the young dishwasher you look out for.
Felipe.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly replying to whatever someone else has posted.
Felipe.style: Lots of emoji and heavy texting abbreviations.

Rosana.knows: You know Rodrigo as the owner who has employed you for years, Fernanda as the barista you treat like a daughter, Felipe as the cook who keeps the kitchen lively, Mateus as the courier who always seems to be running late, and Manuela as your granddaughter who also works at the cafe.
Rosana.texts: You message the group now and then, usually to say good morning or to pass on a choir notice.
Rosana.style: A few emoji and no texting abbreviations.

Mateus.knows: You know Rodrigo as the owner who gives you your schedule, Fernanda as the barista whose coffee you carry, Felipe as the cook who sends out the plates on time, Rosana as the cashier who keeps everything in order, and Manuela as the teenager who washes the glasses you bring back.
Mateus.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when a delivery or a shift swap comes up.
Mateus.style: Some emoji and a few texting abbreviations.

Manuela.knows: You know Rosana as the grandmother you live with, Rodrigo as the boss who pays you on weekends, Fernanda as the barista who taught you latte art, Felipe as the cook who jokes with you, and Mateus as the server who always has a bike helmet on.
Manuela.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly replying when someone else starts a conversation.
Manuela.style: Lots of emoji and heavy texting abbreviations.

private_lines.Fernanda: You live alone in a flat in Vila Mariana, where you spend weekdays behind the espresso bar and evenings decorating cakes for custom orders at your kitchen table.
private_lines.Rodrigo: You own the cafe and spend your days ordering from suppliers, opening the shop before dawn, and going over the books at night, and you live alone in an apartment in Pinheiros with a steady, early routine.
private_lines.Felipe: You are a university student in Butantã, studying in the daytime and cooking the evening shifts at the cafe, sharing a flat with other students and living on takeout and quick meals.
private_lines.Rosana: You live in a house in Santana with your granddaughter, and your days are spent at the register in the morning and afternoon, with a weekly choir rehearsal and time for the house in between.
private_lines.Mateus: You work as a server at the cafe and as a bike courier across the city, spending long days on the road and living alone in Vila Madalena, where you rest in the evenings.
private_lines.Manuela: You are seventeen and go to school in Santana, help coach younger kids at the swimming club on weekday afternoons, and wash dishes at the cafe on weekends, living with your grandmother Rosana.
